presets.name: Competitive
presets.description: Sets the game's CPU and GPU priority to High and its power mode to High performance, and allows dynamic priority boosts.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.description: Raises the game's CPU and GPU priority one step, to Above normal. Everything else stays as it is.

presets.name: Streaming
presets.description: Raises the game's CPU priority to Above normal and sets its power mode to High performance. GPU priority stays as it is, for when a streaming or capture app runs next to the game.
